experiment.title: Fresh source pair-sum orbit-multiplicity typed-TT replication
experiment.objective: Test a target-independent suffix order derived from source pair-sum negation-orbit multiplicity on two fresh ordinary 14-bit curves under the strict typed relation gate.
stopping_rules: classify timeout or memory exhaustion as infrastructure evidence
invalidation_rules: do not treat a failed sampled budget as a failed full solver
do not promote toy evidence to an exponent claim
invalidate if source-only selector checks or direct rho certificates fail
experiment.success_criterion: The fixed pair-sum-orbit selector has an accepted strict sub-full budget on both fresh curves after selector construction and declared source/reconstruction costs are reported.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Either full control fails, or the primary selector has no accepted strict sub-full budget on either fresh curve, or charged selector construction removes the reduction.
